proposals.premise: Visitors can just arrive. Lead with both entrances and put the volunteer request alongside the directions as an option.
proposals.opening: Desktop pairs the entry photo with both routes. Phone puts the routes above the photo. Both show five steps at the main entrance, step-free access through the library courtyard with a bell, indoor chairs, doors 09:00–17:00 and quiet hour 13:00–14:00.
proposals.move: Choose an arrival time in the volunteer form. It appears above Send request. Send at least 30 minutes ahead. The panel then shows “Request sent” and the chosen time.
proposals.tradeoff: Both routes are easy to scan. On a phone, visitors reach the request after the photo.

proposals.premise: Visiting a friend or collecting a secondhand purchase can mean finding the door or arranging to meet. First-time visitors here can use the photo to recognize the door, bells and curb, or request a courtyard meetup.
proposals.opening: Desktop puts the photo beside the entrance choices. Phone puts it above them. Both say “Just come by” and show five steps at the main door, the step-free courtyard bell, indoor chairs, doors 09:00–17:00 and quiet hour 13:00–14:00.
proposals.move: Tap “Show courtyard route” to reveal directions and a volunteer form under the photo. It shows the chosen arrival time before sending and beside “Request sent” afterward. Send at least 30 minutes ahead.
proposals.tradeoff: The photo helps visitors recognize the entrance on arrival. The request takes an extra tap.
